_about.en: Cycle I Mnemos (BG0645-0653), Fated Mnemos (BF0636-0644) and Secret deck 1 (AA0042/46/51/52); one entry per side, id = code_a/b. Mnemos side a: levels[] with text, track, ref (M-code), fx; stats = attribute bonuses. Fated Mnemos: a = penalty (stat, text), b = ability. Secret: slot = 'Technology Secret Card N', level = Inward Odyssey level (null if not printed). [icon] = icon without legend, see uncertain.

It is a language, long forgotten.

text.en:
Permanent. [glyph] is 'one'.
During your Voyages, you will encounter other glyphs that will help you decode the Centimanes Scripts (sequences of glyphs) and find the secret Centimanes paragraphs in the Main Story. These will be denoted by a [hand] at the beginning of the paragraph. If the paragraph doesn't show this symbol, you must've made a mistake in your decoding, don't read it! If that's the case, gain +1[down-triangle].
text.pl:
Stałe. [glyph] oznacza „jeden”.
Podczas Podróży napotkacie inne glify, które pomogą wam odszyfrować Pisma Centimanów (ciągi glifów) i odnaleźć tajne paragrafy Centimanów w Głównej Opowieści. Będą one oznaczone symbolem [hand] na początku paragrafu. Jeśli paragraf nie ma tego symbolu, musieliście popełnić błąd w odszyfrowaniu — nie czytajcie go! W takim przypadku zyskajcie +1[down-triangle].

manual.en: [glyph] = 'one'; decode Centimanes Scripts to find [hand]-marked paragraphs
manual.pl: [glyph] = „jeden”; odszyfruj Pisma Centimanów, by znaleźć paragrafy oznaczone [hand]

manual.en: Paragraph without [hand]: don't read it, gain +1[down-triangle]
manual.pl: Paragraf bez [hand]: nie czytaj, zyskaj +1[down-triangle]
